english.title: Act in disorderly manner at a public election meeting
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were guilty of an illegal practice in that you

(A)_[acted]_
(B)_[incited others to act]_

in a disorderly manner at a

(C)_[political meeting held in a constituency, namely **(..SPECIFY CONSTITUENCY..), between the date of the issue of a writ for the return of a member of Parliament for that constituency and the date at which a return to the writ was made,]_
(D)_[meeting held with reference to a local government election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), in the electoral area for that election in the period beginning with the last date on which notice of the election may be published in accordance with rules made under section 36 and ending with the day of election,]_

for the purpose of preventing the transaction of the business for which the meeting was called together
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 97(1) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
